Title: Enable replication for added VMware VM data disks

Body.Content:
Azure Site Recovery now supports enabling replication for data disks that you add to a VMware VM that's already enabled for disaster recovery. Support is available for VMware VMs protected using the modernized architecture. 

Read the detailed documentation.
